...RESPONDENTS (BY SRI. HARISH GANAPATHI, HCGP FOR R1)
 THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S.482 OF THE CR.P.C PRAYING TO QUASH THE PROCEEDING IN C.C. NO. 2294/2021 OF EAST ZONE WOMENS POLICE STATION PENDING BEFORE HONBLE COURT VI ACMM AT BANGALORE FOR OFFENCE PUNISHABLE U/S 498(A), 417, 420, 506 R/W SEC 34 OF IPC AND SEC 4 OF THE D.P. ACT.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

This Court on 18.06.2024 had passed a peremptory order, which reads as follows:
"Finally, a week's time is granted to comply with the office objections, failing which,
petition would be dismissed without reference to the Bench."
Even today, there is no representation for the petitioner and the office objections are not complied.
Therefore, the petition is dismissed for its non-prosecution.
Pending I.A. is disposed, as a consequence.
